parameters.help_en:
The sender phone number.

If ChannelType is whatsapp, this is the phone number registered and bindng with WhatsApp. You can view it on the <props="china">Channel Management (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">Channel Management (https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > Management > WABA Management > Phone Number Management page.
If ChannelType is messenger, this is the Page ID. You can view it on the <props="china">Channel Management (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">Channel Management (https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > Management > Public Page page.
If ChannelType is instagram, this is the Instagram professional Account ID. You can view it on the <props="china">Channel Management (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">Channel Management (https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > Management > Professional Account page.
<props="intl">- If ChannelType is viber, this is the Viber Service ID. You can view it on the Channel Management (https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList) > Management > Service ID Management page.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
发送方号码。

当ChannelType为whatsapp时为注册并绑定WhatsApp的电话号码。在<props="china">通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>>管理>WABA管理>号码管理界面查看。
当ChannelType为messenger时为公共主页ID（Page ID）。在<props="china">通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>>管理>公共主页界面查看。
当ChannelType为instagram时为instagram专业账户ID（Account ID）。在<props="china">通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>>管理>专业账户界面查看。
<props="intl">- 当ChannelType为viber时为Viber服务号ID（Service ID）。在通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)>管理>服务号管理界面查看。</props>

fields.help_en:
The recipient phone number.

If ChannelType is whatsapp, this is the phone number of the message recipient.
If ChannelType is messenger, this is the Page-Scoped User ID generated when the user interacts with the Facebook page.
If ChannelType is instagram, this is the Instagram User ID generated when the user interacts with the Instagram business or creator account.
<props="intl">- If ChannelType is viber, this is the phone number of the message recipient.</props>
fields.help_zh:
接收方号码。

当ChannelType为whatapp时为消息接收方的电话号码。
当ChannelType为messenger为与Facebook页面消息互动时生成的一个Page-Scoped User ID。
当ChannelType为instagram时为用户与Instagram商业账号或创作者账号消息互动时生成的Instagram User ID。
<props="intl">- 当ChannelType为viber时为消息接收方的电话号码。</props>

The Viber message type. This parameter is for the international site. China site users can ignore this parameter.
<props="intl">Valid values:</props>
<props="intl">- pormotion: marketing or promotional messages.</props>
<props="intl">- transaction: notification messages.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
Viber消息类型，此参数为国际站参数，中国站可忽略此参数。
<props="intl">取值：</props>
<props="intl">-  pormotion：营销、促销类消息。</props>
<props="intl">-  transaction：通知类消息。</props>
parameters.name: label

parameters.help_en: The tag information. Custom tag information for Viber message sending
parameters.help_zh: 标签信息，Viber消息发送时自定义标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The fallback trigger time. This parameter is for the international site. China site users can ignore this parameter. <props="intl">If no delivery receipt is returned within the specified time, the fallback is triggered. If this parameter is not specified, the fallback is triggered only when the message fails to send or a failure status report is received. Unit: seconds. Minimum value: 60. Maximum value: 43200.</props>
parameters.help_zh: 回落触发时间。此参数为国际站参数，中国站可忽略此参数。<props="intl">消息在指定时间内没有返回已到达回执消息时进行回落, 不填代表不根据此时间判断回落，只有发送失败和有失败的状态报告时才会回落。单位：秒。最小值：60，最大值：43200。</props>
parameters.name: fall_back_duration

parameters.help_en:
The fallback rule. This parameter is for the international site. China site users can ignore this parameter.
</props><props="intl">Valid values:</props>
<props="intl">- undelivered: the fallback is triggered when the message cannot be delivered to the device. During sending, the template and parameters must pass validation. Blocked templates or blocked numbers are not validated. This rule is used by default if the parameter value is empty.</props>
<props="intl">- sentFailed: the fallback is triggered when validation of the template or template variables fails. Only channelType, type, messageType, to, and from (whether it exists) are strictly validated.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
回落规则。此参数为国际站参数，中国站可忽略此参数。
</props><props="intl">取值：</props>
<props="intl">- undelivered：消息不能发送到端时进行回落（在发送状态时模板、参数需要校验通过，模板被封、号码被封等不做校验）。参数值为空时默认使用此规则。</props>
<props="intl">-  sentFailed：消息在校验模板、模板变量等参数时，校验不通过也会进行回落。只会强校验channelType, type, messageType, to, from(是否存在) 几个参数。</props>
parameters.name: fall_back_rule
